QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Living Fossil
QuestInfo.0: Find out where Eremos would like you to go for the next phase of your training.
QuestInfo.1: The Ryuul appraise the fossil claim it is highly valuable. Hunt Drakes and analyze samples you take from them with the Data Collector.
QuestInfo.2: You discovered the data collector in the Drakes' habitat and can activate it by placing a Drake Cell Sample in it.
